title: Prototype model-serving stack with monitoring

nodes.label: Inference Client
nodes.description: Submits user prompts and displays completions, errors, and latency-facing status for the prototype serving flow.

nodes.label: Model Serving API
nodes.description: Single request entry: validates input, applies prompt/config from artifacts, calls the model runtime, and returns the response.

nodes.label: Model Runtime
nodes.description: Loads the selected model artifact and generates responses within the prototype latency and spend expectations.

nodes.label: Model & Prompt Artifact Store
nodes.description: Reusable store for versioned model artifacts, prompt templates, and serving configuration consumed by the runtime path.

nodes.label: Telemetry Log Store
nodes.description: Retains request/response samples plus latency, error, token, and cost events for later inspection and monitoring reads.

nodes.label: Monitoring & Alerting Service
nodes.description: Reads telemetry to compute availability, latency, error-rate, token/cost, and sample-quality signals; flags threshold breaches to operators only.

assumptions: The word production is treated as prototype scope: single environment, no HA, rollout, RBAC, CI/CD, or topology detail.
Model source is abstracted behind the runtime so a self-hosted or managed model can be swapped without redesigning the serving path.
No retrieval augmentation, tools, write actions, or guardrail pipeline are included beyond basic request validation.
Monitoring observes and flags signals for humans; it does not mutate models, prompts, ranking, or live configuration.
Stored model/prompt artifacts and telemetry are reused, so retrieval_or_reuse is true while learning_or_release remains false.
